text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian wins the Japan Cup and, in the midst of thunderous applause, she and Hishi Amazon vow to continue racing each other forever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day, Narita Brian goes to visit Biwa Hayahide at the hospital. When she arrives, however, her sister is nowhere to be seen…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide's injury has healed and she's back to training with all her might. The two sisters swear to battle at the Arima Kinen.
